pvpcoach.title: PvP Coach
pvpcoach.empty.title: No fights recorded yet
pvpcoach.empty.text: Fight another player and PvP Coach analyses the fight automatically. When it ends you get a score and the most important tip in chat, and the full report right here.
pvpcoach.empty.practice: Want to practise alone? Turn on "Track mobs" in Settings and fight a few zombies.
pvpcoach.report.no_tips: Nothing to point out: a solid, even fight.
pvpcoach.tip.weak_hits: %s%% of your attacks were made before your weapon was charged. Wait for the attack indicator to fill: one full-charge hit beats two weak ones.
pvpcoach.tip.accuracy: %s of your %s swings hit nothing. Keep your crosshair on your opponent and only swing when they are in reach.
pvpcoach.tip.sprint: Only %s%% of your hits had sprint knockback. Re-sprint (W-tap) between hits so every hit pushes your opponent away and keeps your combo going.
pvpcoach.tip.trading: You took more hits than you landed (%s vs %s). Space better: back off after each hit so your opponent has to walk into your reach.
pvpcoach.tip.combo_taken: You took a %s-hit combo. When you are being comboed, strafe sideways, jump-reset or block to break the chain instead of running straight back.
pvpcoach.tip.retotem_missed: After %s totem pop(s) you never held a new totem again. Refill your offhand right after every pop.
pvpcoach.tip.retotem_slow: It took you %ss on average to hold a new totem after a pop. Practise your offhand refill and aim for under one second.
pvpcoach.tip.eat_interrupted: You were hit %s times while eating. Make space first (pearl away, strafe, block) and eat when you are safe.
pvpcoach.tip.shield_unused: You had a shield in your offhand but never raised it. Block when your opponent is about to hit, especially against axes and crits.
pvpcoach.tip.close_range: Your average hit distance was only %s blocks. Use your full reach and hit first instead of fighting face to face.
pvpcoach.tip.no_crits: You landed no critical hits. When your opponent cannot hit back, jump and hit while falling for 50%% extra damage.
pvpcoach.tip.good_charge: Patient hitting: %s%% of your attacks were fully charged.
pvpcoach.tip.good_aim: Sharp aim: %s%% of your swings connected.
pvpcoach.tip.good_sprint: Great sprint resets: %s%% of your hits had sprint knockback.
pvpcoach.tip.clean_win: Clean win: your opponent only hit you %s times.
pvpcoach.progress.no_mistakes: No recurring mistakes. Keep it up!
pvpcoach.settings.chat.tooltip: Post a one-line summary with your score and top tip in chat when a fight ends.
pvpcoach.settings.mobs.tooltip: Also analyse fights against mobs, so you can practise in singleplayer. Off by default so normal survival fights do not fill your history.
pvpcoach.settings.timeout: Fight ends after: %s s without hits
pvpcoach.settings.timeout.tooltip: How long you and your opponent have to stop hitting each other before the fight counts as over.
pvpcoach.settings.min.tooltip: Fights with fewer hits (landed + taken) are not saved, so a single stray hit is not a fight.
pvpcoach.settings.clear.confirm: Click again to delete all fights
